data.narrative:
Mbodi AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Xavier Chi and Sebastian Peralta that has raised $4.4M to date. The comparable universe spans 10 private firms in robotics and manufacturing, alongside one public company (277810.KQ). Peer firms include Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Valuation analysis relies primarily on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median approaches proved inapplicable. The robotics and manufacturing sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with aligned characteristics—only one direct peer at seed stage was identified. The stage-progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $4.4M total raised, treating capital raised as a valuation proxy and accounting for expected value creation between seed and Series A. This approach yields an implied valuation of $11M.

The triangulated range is $9M (low) to $13M (high), with a median of $11M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 2.5x multiplier to frontier robotics (where capital efficiency and time-to-revenue vary significantly), the representativeness of the broader peer set given limited seed-stage data, and stage-specific risk factors not captured in pure progression models. Additional valuation weight would require either expanded peer comparables at adjacent stages or transaction data from similar-tier robotics companies.
